name: Tiny Desk Tidy
description: Ten two-minute tidying ideas for a calmer desk.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A deck of tiny tidying ideas for your desk and screen, shown on Calm Cards.
help.goal: Nothing to finish. Even one tiny tidy is a fine break.
howToPlay: Read the idea on the card.
Press Show more for a hint on how to do it.
Try it, or press Next for something different.
tips: Lift with care and skip anything that does not feel comfortable. These are only ideas.
